about: Hosts `node scripts/facts/cli.ts verify` may fetch. They are the news hosts the owner allowed in this cloud environment (2026-11-24). Any other host is reported 'not-allowed' and nothing is fetched; widening this list needs the owner's approval in the environment settings first. On a machine with open network (GitHub Actions, a laptop) use --any-host instead.
